title: One WorkSafe court summary (www.worksafe.govt.nz/laws-and-regulations/prosecutions/court-summaries/<slug>/, HTML)

landmarks:
id="main-page-content" holding

Court Summary - at a glance

Label:
value
rows: Defendant name, Industry, Date of offence, Facts in brief, Offence section, Date(s) charged, Court, Plea, Final decision date (), Decision, Fine imposed, Maximum fine available, Reparation, Safety lessons learned, Related Documents

signals_note: GET the item's address from the list, through the fetch gate, 5 s apart; landed verbatim by hash.
notes: Seen on six summaries, 21 October 2026 (2017 to 2025). The at-a-glance block repeats Date of offence, Plea, Decision, Final decision date and Fine imposed; the first occurrence is read. Joint defendants share one page ('Joan Carpenters Limited and Church Bay Services Limited'), the offence section then giving a line per defendant by initials. Older summaries charge under the Health and Safety in Employment Act 1992; many name the Act only as 'HSWA'. WorkSafe publishes a code in place of a defendant it does not name ('2019-A'). The fine field is prose: a starting point, discounts, a split, instalments. Facts in brief and Safety lessons describe the victim and the place, and are never read.
process: Recognise the page; set it aside whole if it is not the shape.

One action row keyed by the slug: the label rows as stated (the offence and charge dates as text, and as a day only where the field is one day; the final decision date from its datetime); each Act the offence section names by title, else its abbreviation as stated; the fine's figure only where the field states one figure.
Parties: the Defendant name field (else the heading), split on ' and ' only between two names that each carry a legal ending.

Withheld where WorkSafe writes the name withheld or suppressed or publishes a code in its place, or where the page states a suppression and the party is not one organisation alone; then the heading, slug and address are not kept, and the key is the slug's hash.
gates: Every listed item is an action row, a catch-log line or 'not captured' (check.py).
No withheld name, no address column, no street-shaped value on a view (check.py).

process: Recognise the page; set it aside whole if it is not the shape.
